policy.namespace: ips_<name> module, gw2a_ips_<name>.v wrapper, ip/<name>/ package dir
policy.synthesis: synth_gowin -noalu (docs/IP_CORE_SOP.md trap T12: ALU carry-chain mapping produced silicon-confirmed errors)
policy.golden: every core ships models/<name>.py which computes the reference digest independently of the RTL; the gate requires RTL digest == model digest and forbids back-filling expectations from simulation (SOP trap T1)
policy.non_vacuity: gate mutates numeric literals in a copy of the RTL and requires the digest to change; a core whose digest is insensitive to RTL edits fails closed
policy.board: DEFERRED for all series cores until a board run is recorded, mirroring scripts/harness.ps1 release-check which requires board_evidence == DEFERRED
